payload.content:
name: observability-plane-conformance
nodes:
  monitor:
    type: compute
    source:
      name: exact-monitor-image
      version: '*'
    resources:
      ram: 1073741824
      cpu: 1
    os: linux
    os_distribution: ubuntu
    os_version: '24.04'
    services:
    - port: 80
      protocol: tcp
      name: http
    runtime:
      service_listeners:
      - service_listener_id: telemetry
        service: http
        address: 0.0.0.0
        port: 80
        protocol: tcp
        address_family: ipv4
        scope: wildcard
